osm_road_mask — DRIVE japan op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.osm_road_mask(graph: 'dict', *, step: 'float' = 0.5, margin: 'float' = 6.0, bbox=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivejapan; drivejapan.osm_road_mask(graph: 'dict', *, step: 'float' = 0.5, margin: 'float' = 6.0, bbox=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("osm_road_mask"))

Usage

Binary (2-valued) image of the union of roads, with edges drawn as line segments of given width (with round ends).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

画素 (r, c) の中心 = (xmin + (c + ½) step, ymin + (r + ½) step)、行は y の増える向き(数学座標。表示で上下を返す)。返り値 {"mask": (H, W) bool, "xmin", "ymin", "step", "shape", "area_m2": 画素数 × step²}。Raises ValueError: step ≤ 0、画像が 4e7 画素を超える(step を粗く)。
